description: This PHP script facilitates an automated silent upgrade process for a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM installation. It includes functions for argument handling, checks for CLI execution, and sequentially invokes multiple upgrade steps through included PHP scripts, handling errors at each stage.

methods.name: build_argument_string
methods.description: Constructs a shell argument string from an array of arguments, substituting current directory paths for '.' and '..', and escaping arguments for shell safety.
